headline: The Edmund Fitzgerald is lost
post_facts: Largest ship on the Great Lakes at launch

scenes.text: [solemnly] On this day, in nineteen seventy-five... the Edmund Fitzgerald sank in a Lake Superior storm.

scenes.label: Great Lakes
scenes.caption: The Edmund Fitzgerald under way
scenes.text: [gravely] When launched, she was the largest ship on the Great Lakes.

scenes.label: crew members lost
scenes.text: [softly] All twenty-nine men aboard were lost.

scenes.caption: The freighter on the Great Lakes
scenes.title: Found 530 feet down
scenes.text: [solemnly] Her wreck was found in five hundred thirty feet of icy water.

scenes.title: Remembered in song
scenes.text: [gently] A year later, Gordon Lightfoot's ballad made sure they'd be remembered.
